description: False-positive allowlist for the Critical Activity Coverage Scanner. Each entry MUST have a documented reason. Three categories: (1) TRANSITIVE — the activity is registered by a parent hook/provider that this file consumes; (2) INFRA — this file IS the build-guard infrastructure and cannot register an activity on itself; (3) READ-WITH-SIDE-EFFECT — the POST is an idempotent auto-triggered refresh, not a user-initiated mutation. Reviewer MUST re-validate entries when the referenced transitive provider changes.

entries.reason: INFRA — auth gate (login/signup). Runs BEFORE AppShell mounts; no revenue work in flight. If reload happens mid-signup, user retries. Auth is the precondition for critical activities to exist, not a critical activity itself.

TRANSITIVE — `isProcessing` is a derived display boolean (job?.status === 'processing'). The actual bulk-job activity is registered by `bulk-worker-provider.tsx` (`bulk-job`, interrupt). This widget only renders progress.

READ-WITH-SIDE-EFFECT — `/api/inventory/batches/expiry-check` POST is an idempotent auto-mount refresh (FEFOEngine.markExpiredBatches is a no-op on already-expired batches). Not user-initiated; reloading mid-call just re-runs the same idempotent check on next mount.

TRANSITIVE — `isProcessing` is a derived display boolean (job?.status === 'PROCESSING'). The actual migration-job activity is registered by `migration-processor-provider.tsx` (`migration-job`, interrupt). This widget only renders progress.
TRANSITIVE — `isProcessing` is a prop drilled from `use-pos-checkout.ts`, which already registers `pos-payment` (in-flight). This component only renders the payment UI.

TRANSITIVE — `/api/transactions/sync` POST is the outbox sync push. The `outbox-sync` activity is registered by `app-shell.tsx` gated on `pendingOutboxCount > 0` — which is true whenever a sync is in-flight (items are pending until ack arrives).
TRANSITIVE — `isProcessing` is a prop drilled from `use-pos-checkout.ts`, which already registers `pos-payment` (in-flight). This component only composes the POS layout.

TRANSITIVE — `postMessage` is to a BroadcastChannel (not a Worker). This is the outbox sync engine itself; the `outbox-sync` activity is registered by `app-shell.tsx` gated on `pendingOutboxCount > 0`.
INFRA — this IS the build-guard UI. `postMessage(AETHER_ACTIVATE_UPDATE)` is the SW activation trigger. Registering a critical activity here would gate the update mechanism on itself.
INFRA — `postMessage` sends prefetch hints to the SW. Prefetch is a background optimization, not a critical activity (interrupting it has no user-visible consequence).

INFRA — this IS the build-guard coordinator. `postMessage(AETHER_CLIENT_BUILD)` reports the current buildId to the SW. Registering a critical activity here would gate the detection mechanism on itself.
